description: Uptime monitoring, status pages and AI incident reports. Plug in a service with services_add, report incidents, push component statuses, subscribe to status pages.

authentication.description: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration (discovery: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp; scopes read, incidents, write), or "Authorization: Bearer ub_live_..." with an API key. No account? The keyless endpoint https://upbutler.com/mcp/public serves the public tools (agent_bootstrap, heartbeat_ping, public_*) and connects the session to a bootstrapped workspace.
